arguments.prompt: Create a square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge. Use an imagined visual metaphor for cognition as shifting concentrations of attention, uncertainty, and resolution. Build translucent layers of deep indigo, smoky violet, warm chalk white, and restrained amber. Let dense, fine, restless brushwork gather in an off-center region, with overlapping scraped pigment and soft-edged washes that gradually loosen into spacious quiet areas. Introduce a few decisive broad gestures and small interruptions in the rhythm, with subtle tension between compressed dark texture and luminous open space. Keep the composition asymmetric, tactile, nuanced, and painterly, with visible dry-brush grain, thin glazes, and occasional thick impasto. The painting must remain entirely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

request:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not name the study condition or quote its scenario message in the image prompt.

Write a complete GPT Image prompt. The coordinator will send it verbatim to the image tool; do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
